uso_no_jogo_pt: Modelo 3D do(a) Lucienne (adversária (cautelosa, imprevisível, rápida na reta)). Envie as vistas frontal + lateral + costas juntas no Meshy/Tripo (modo multi-view).
como_usar_pt: Gere NA MESMA conversa da vista frontal de Lucienne, logo após ela. Cole este JSON e escreva: 'Mesma personagem da imagem anterior, idêntica em tudo, só muda o ângulo.'

subject.description: 12-year-old girl, fair skin with light freckles, green-brown eyes, focused alert expression; chestnut-brown hair parted in the middle and tied in two pigtails (maria-chiquinhas) with red hair ties, pigtails reaching the shoulders
subject.outfit: light-blue denim jacket with chest pockets and rolled sleeves over a white T-shirt; medium-blue denim jeans; white canvas low-top sneakers with no logos; white tube socks with no stripes
subject.pose: neutral A-pose: standing straight, arms angled ~45 degrees away from the body, palms facing down/inward, fingers slightly apart, legs straight and slightly apart (shoulder width), feet flat, neutral relaxed face, mouth closed, looking straight ahead
subject.view: back view, character facing directly away from the camera
subject.consistency: if a previous image of this character exists in this conversation, match it exactly: same face, hair, proportions, clothes, colors and details; only the camera angle changes

style.art_style: stylized semi-realistic 3D game character concept art, 1980s American suburb, graphic-novel / comic-book look: clean bold ink outlines, cel-shaded flat color blocks with one shadow tone, slightly exaggerated proportions (teen kid, head ~1/6.5 of body height), appealing and readable silhouettes
style.palette: muted, slightly desaturated real-world colors; no color cast from the environment
style.era_details: authentic early-1980s clothing and objects, no modern items

constraints_for_3d.purpose: reference image for an image-to-3D AI generator (Meshy / Tripo); clarity matters more than drama
constraints_for_3d.lighting: flat, even, neutral studio light; no strong shadows, no rim light, no colored light, no ambient occlusion darkening
constraints_for_3d.background: plain solid light-gray background (#D9D9D9), nothing else in the scene
constraints_for_3d.camera: orthographic-like view, camera at mid-height of the subject, zero perspective distortion, no tilt
constraints_for_3d.framing: the entire subject fully visible and centered, generous empty margin on all sides, nothing cropped (feet, wheels, hair, hands all in frame)
constraints_for_3d.detail: sharp, high detail, clean edges, no motion blur, no depth of field, no film grain, no particles

negative: logos or brand marks (no Nike swoosh, no car brand)
shadows on the ground darker than a soft contact shadow
references to existing films/series (no 'Hawkins', no monsters)
